ess.title: Electronic Sales System
ess.shortDescription: From the browser: issue e-invoices and e-receipts, send them to the tax authority, and track status — no software to install.
ess.description: ESS is the electronic sales system for businesses that need certified e-invoices and e-receipts. You work in the browser: create the document, review it, submit it to the Egyptian Tax Authority, and follow acceptance or rejection in one place. Manage items, customers, and suppliers; register branches and POS devices; and code your items on the tax portal. Legal signing happens with a USB token on your PC through ESA — without installing invoicing software on every machine.

features.title: E-invoices
features.detail:
In the browser you build the invoice: seller and buyer, items, quantities, and tax, then review totals before you save. You edit the draft, and you issue an adjustment when price, quantity, or discount changes after issuance.

After submit you follow the document at the tax authority: accepted, rejected, or still processing. All of it stays in the browser on any device — no invoicing software to install on every PC.

features.title: Receipts and returns
features.detail:
Beside the invoice you issue a sales receipt or a return in the same system. You pick the type, add lines, send the receipt to the tax authority, and see whether it was accepted or rejected.

Management shows receipts and their lines, with status actions limited by each user’s permission. Built for companies that need an e-receipt next to the invoice without a separate cashier product.

features.title: Items, customers, suppliers
features.detail:
Master data is stored once: items and services, invoice and receipt customers, and suppliers. You search them inside the document form instead of retyping, and you can add a customer quickly from the same screen while you issue.

When you leave an older system you import items and customers in bulk and follow the import job until it finishes. An update to an item or customer shows up on the next invoices and receipts.

features.title: Tax portal follow-up
features.detail:
Inside ESS you see recent invoices and receipts as they appear at the tax authority, without opening the official portal every time. You review GPC and portal codes, submit item coding requests, and follow the result.

The aim is one screen for the team: issue, send, code, and track accept or reject in the same company account.

features.title: Branches, POS, and permissions
features.detail:
You run more than one company from the same login, with a profile per company: branches, activities, POS devices, currencies, taxes, and units. Each user sees only what their permission allows, and you can switch company without a full re-login.

You register the signature and seal tokens used with ESA, and you set print templates and notifications. Central settings feed the invoice and receipt forms so branch and POS data is not typed again on every document.

features.title: Print that matches your work
features.detail:
You print A4 or A5 for the office, or thermal at the point of sale, using the template linked to the company. The template pulls company name, branch, buyer, lines, and totals so the look stays the same in every branch.

You pick the template that matches the activity in settings, and you reprint from the view screen when needed without recreating the document.

ers.title: POS E-Receipts
ers.shortDescription: A fast cashier screen to issue e-receipts and link them to the tax authority — without the full invoice workflow.
ers.description: ERS is built for retail and point-of-sale teams that need an e-receipt at the cashier — not an invoice. The cashier picks items, issues the receipt, and sends it to the Egyptian Tax Authority. You manage POS devices, branches, and customers, and import receipts when needed. The dashboard shows accepted, rejected, and net daily sales so you can follow the shift from anywhere.

features.title: Receipt from the cashier screen
features.detail:
The cashier path is short on purpose: pick items from the grid, set quantity, then issue a sales receipt or a return. There are no invoice screens and no fields the seller does not need during the shift.

After issue, the receipt is sent to the tax authority in the same step. The design is for point-of-sale speed: fewer taps, and fewer entry mistakes at peak hours.

features.title: POS devices and branches
features.detail:
Each cashier device is registered as a POS linked to a branch and a tax-approved activity. The receipt is attributed to the right device and branch so shifts do not mix, and the tax authority does not reject the receipt for the wrong POS data.

In settings you add branches and devices, connect the tax link and activity codes once, then the cashier works on the simple screen with no daily reconfiguration.

features.title: Items, customers, and import
features.detail:
You manage items and customers on their own screens: prices, taxes, units, and customer type. At the cashier the item is ready to pick, and you can attach a customer when needed without slowing the shift.

If you have an external source — a file or an older system — you import items, customers, or receipts in bulk and follow the import job until it finishes, instead of typing every record.

features.title: Accept and reject status
features.detail:
Receipt management shows the list and the lines, and separates valid documents, those accepted by the tax authority, those still processing, and those rejected. Rejected items are obvious so a supervisor can fix them before the day closes.

Returns have their own view so they do not mix with shift sales. Each status comes from the tax authority, not a local guess on the device.

features.title: Thermal cashier print
features.detail:
Templates are set for a thermal printer at the point of sale: a short customer receipt right after the sale, with no layout work each shift. You can reprint from the view screen if the paper jams or the customer asks for a copy.

Seller, branch, and POS data come from company settings so the receipt looks the same on every cashier.

features.title: Shift sales board
features.detail:
The dashboard summarizes today, this week, or this month: total receipts, valid, accepted by the tax authority, in process, and rejected. It shows sales versus returns and net for the shift.

A supervisor follows this from any connected device without standing at the cashier. The financial view counts only valid receipts so in-process numbers do not distort close-of-day decisions.

esa.title: Electronic Signature Agent
esa.shortDescription: ESA is an advanced electronic signature application developed as a practical and modern alternative to ePass2003, enabling the secure and easy use of e-signature and e-seal certificates across different platforms and electronic portals.
esa.description: ESA is an advanced electronic signature application developed as a practical and modern alternative to ePass2003, enabling the secure and easy use of e-signature and e-seal certificates across different platforms and electronic portals. It is designed to meet the growing reliance on electronic signing in digital transactions and provide a reliable solution for businesses and electronic services across different environments.

features.title: A practical and modern alternative to ePass2003
features.detail: ESA was designed as a modern, practical alternative to ePass2003, offering a smoother and more stable signing experience for daily business operations.

features.title: Wide support for devices and portals
features.detail: ESA supports a broad range of electronic signing devices and works with many government and digital portals, making it a unified and practical solution for secure document signing across platforms.

features.title: Simpler and more stable signing
features.detail: The solution is built to deliver a more intuitive signing experience with a stable workflow and a clearer user journey while keeping the highest security standards in place.

features.title: Higher efficiency and reliable security
features.detail: With ESA, organizations benefit from greater signing efficiency, dependable protection, and a more reliable digital process that supports secure operations across multiple systems.
